blurb: The Cuming County Historical Society Museum Complex is made up of several buildings filled with historical displays. The Complex consist of the 1904 Chicago Northwestern Depot; Union Pacific caboose; St. Matthew’s Church; District #34 one-room schoolhouse built in 1912; Dinklage Heritage Museum; and Tractor & Antique Machinery Building.
